detector: largest red HSV contour and minimum enclosing circle from run.detect_red_target
scope: target-center localization only; no arm controller, physical reach, or terminal visual confirmation
scene_limitations: The scene is rendered by MuJoCo; it is not a physical camera or measured lighting setup.
A target-only tabletop scene isolates perception and excludes arm self-occlusion.
Clutter placement, object colors, and lighting strengths are authored benchmark conditions.
The 4.5 cm target-radius localization criterion is not a physical reaching-success measure.
